title: negundo interior
intro: Negundo interior, commonly known as the Mexican Buckeye, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The Negundo interior plant has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of Negundo interior include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal applications.
